subthemes.name: Boards & classroom workload
items: I feel the board syllabus is more than I can finish on time.
Deadlines from different subjects keep piling up.
I can't tell where to start with pending academic work.
I lose personal time because of academic load.
I feel I need to study longer than I can realistically sustain.
I have no breathing room between tests and submissions.
I feel school hours stretch into my evenings and weekends.
I feel I'll never catch up with my pending topics.

subthemes.name: Competitive-exam anxiety (JEE / NEET / CUET / others)
items: I worry about my competitive-exam preparation almost daily.
A bad mock test score ruins the rest of the week.
I feel my rank or percentile predictions decide my life.
I compare my scores and ranks with coaching batchmates.
I feel I'm falling behind my coaching batch.
I feel scared of the actual entrance exam day.
I feel I don't have a backup plan if my top exam doesn't work.
I feel I need to keep solving problems just to stay in the race.

subthemes.name: Performance pressure & fear of failure
items: I feel I have to top every test to feel okay about myself.
I worry about disappointing teachers, tutors or parents.
I feel one bad exam will mark me for years.
I feel scared to attempt questions in case I get them wrong.
Even when I do well, I immediately worry about the next test.
I feel my worth depends on my next result.
I avoid certain subjects because I'm scared to score badly.

subthemes.name: Concentration, memory & study-habit strain
items: Study-related worry makes it hard to concentrate.
I re-read the same page without taking anything in.
I feel mentally foggy after demanding days of study.
I forget things I just revised.
I need more breaks than I used to to get through study.
My mind drifts even when I try to focus.
I feel I don't have a study method that works for me anymore.

subthemes.name: Career direction & stream uncertainty
items: I feel unsure about my future career path, and it stresses me.
I feel I don't know what I'm actually good at.
I feel pressured to pick a career before I'm ready.
I compare my 'timeline' with peers and feel behind.
I feel the field I want is too competitive to break into.
I feel what I love doing isn't a 'real' career.
I feel my dreams are too small or too big for my family.
Big life questions keep looping in my head.

subthemes.name: College admissions worry
items: I worry about whether I'll get into the colleges I want.
I feel one admission result will decide my life.
I worry about rejection from my dream college.
I compare my admission prospects with batchmates.
I feel I don't have a clear admissions plan.
I worry about fees and whether my family can afford my college choices.
I feel pressure to pick a 'safe' college over one I want.
I feel scared about the gap between boards and admission results.

subthemes.name: Family financial pressure
items: I worry about money or my family's financial pressure.
I feel guilty about the cost of coaching, tuition or study material.
I feel pressure to start earning as soon as possible.
I think about my family's finances more than I'd like to.
I feel I'm a financial burden on my family.
I avoid asking for things I need because of money stress.
I feel fees or living costs are causing tension at home.

subthemes.name: Future-conversation avoidance
items: I avoid talking about my future with my family.
I avoid discussing options I'm considering because of the reaction.
I don't tell my family what I'm actually spending on.
I postpone big conversations about my future to avoid stress.
I don't ask for help with planning because I worry about judgement.
I feel I need to look like I have it figured out to my family.
I feel ashamed to raise financial topics at home.

subthemes.name: Parental expectations
items: I feel the weight of my family's expectations about my career.
My family already has a plan for what I should do.
I feel my parents' happiness depends on my results.
I feel I owe my family a particular future that may not fit me.
I feel I can't tell my family what I actually want.
I feel I'm living my family's dream, not mine.
I feel scared of disappointing my parents.
I feel my parents don't understand what I'm going through.

subthemes.name: Comparison within family & community
items: My parents compare me with cousins, siblings or classmates.
I'm compared to a 'topper' or 'successful cousin' at home.
I feel I'm never as good as the person my family holds up.
Relatives ask questions that make me feel smaller.
I feel I have to perform for the extended family.
I feel I'm being measured by other families' standards.
I feel invisible when a sibling does well.

subthemes.name: Home environment & tension
items: My home feels tense right now.
I feel I can't relax at home.
I feel caught between family members.
I avoid being at home when I can.
Someone at home is going through a tough time, and it affects me.
I feel lonely at home even with people around.
I feel I have to look okay all the time at home.
I feel my home is stressful because of exam / career pressure around me.

subthemes.name: Communication with parents
items: I don't tell my parents when something is really bothering me.
I hide how bad things are so I don't worry them.
I say 'I'm fine' at home when I'm not.
I feel my parents don't ask how I'm feeling, only about results.
I avoid honest conversations with my parents.
I feel I need to protect my parents from how I'm doing.
I feel my parents and I speak different languages about my life.

subthemes.name: Self-identity & imposter feelings
items: I feel like a fraud when I'm praised or do well.
I feel other people are more capable or sorted than I am.
I think my success so far has been luck, not ability.
I feel I'll be found out as not good enough.
I minimise my achievements when I talk about them.
I measure myself against the best people in every room.
I feel I don't know who I really am right now.
I feel pulled in different directions by school, family and friends.

subthemes.name: Social comparison (including social media)
items: I compare my progress with others and feel behind.
Social media makes me feel I'm not doing enough.
I compare my body, looks or lifestyle with people online.
I feel other people's lives look better than mine.
I feel my friends are achieving more than me.
I stop posting because of how I think it will be judged.
I compare my college prospects with batchmates and feel anxious.

subthemes.name: Breakup, rejection & close-relationship conflict
items: A recent breakup, rejection or conflict with someone close is still affecting me.
I keep thinking about a relationship that ended or is strained.
I feel let down by someone close to me.
I have an unresolved argument with someone close.
I feel unsupported by my partner, best friend or family right now.
Seeing a person or their updates still hurts.
I had to end a connection that was hurting me, and it still weighs on me.
I feel I'm losing a bond that really mattered to me.

subthemes.name: Friendship loss & social isolation
items: I don't have anyone I can talk to honestly.
I feel alone with my problems.
I feel I have lost touch with people I used to be close to.
My conversations stay surface-level even when I want more.
I feel invisible in the groups I'm part of.
I spend most evenings alone with my thoughts.
I keep my distress to myself even when it's hurting me.

subthemes.name: Overwhelm & distress intensity
items: I feel overwhelmed and can't shake it off quickly.
Small problems feel much bigger than they should.
I feel like I'm running on edge most of the day.
I have no space left in my head for anything new.
Stress symptoms spill into my sleep, appetite or focus.
I feel I can barely keep up with everyday things.
I feel one more thing could tip me over.
Even small changes to my plan feel too much to handle.

subthemes.name: Anxiety & restlessness
items: I feel on edge or anxious without a clear reason.
My heart races or my breathing speeds up when I'm not active.
I worry about things that haven't happened yet.
I feel restless and can't sit still for long.
I notice knots in my stomach or a tight chest.
I expect something bad is about to happen.
I replay stressful moments long after they are over.

subthemes.name: Low mood & motivation
items: I feel low or unmotivated even when nothing specific is wrong.
Things I usually enjoy feel flat or not worth the effort.
I feel heavy or weighed down when I wake up.
I cry more easily than usual, or feel like crying.
Making small decisions feels harder than it used to.
I feel less interested in future plans I was looking forward to.
I feel I'm just going through the motions.
I feel disconnected from my day as it passes.

subthemes.name: Avoidant / escape coping
items: I use scrolling, gaming or snacks to switch off difficult feelings.
I binge-watch content late into the night to avoid thinking.
I overeat or lose interest in food when I'm stressed.
I rely on caffeine or energy drinks to cope with the day.
I buy or shop more than I planned to feel better.
I distract myself rather than face what is actually bothering me.
I use substances (alcohol, tobacco) to cope.

subthemes.name: Sleep timing & quantity
items: I feel tired because screens or study push my sleep later.
I sleep fewer hours than I know I need.
My bedtime varies a lot from one night to the next.
I stay up late even when I have a full day ahead.
I lose an hour or more to my phone after lying down.
I only sleep properly on weekends.
I wake up earlier than I want to and can't sleep again.
I feel I never get a proper stretch of sleep.

subthemes.name: Sleep quality & stress dreams
items: Stress makes it hard to fall asleep.
I wake up during the night and struggle to go back to sleep.
My thoughts get louder once I lie down.
I wake up and feel I didn't really rest.
I have unsettling dreams about exams or what's coming.
I feel physically tense when I try to sleep.
I grind my teeth or wake up with a tight jaw.

subthemes.name: Daytime energy, meals & body care
items: I feel foggy or low on energy during the day.
I rely on caffeine or energy drinks to function.
I crash in the afternoon and struggle to recover.
I skip meals or forget to drink water when I'm busy.
I don't get proper movement or walking in my day.
I rarely get fresh air or daylight.
My body feels stiff or sore from sitting too long.
I notice headaches, acidity or stomach aches more often.

subthemes.name: Digital overuse & time pressure
items: I spend more time on screens than I'd like to.
I lose study time to scrolling, gaming or videos.
I feel bad after long phone sessions, but I keep going.
I use my phone first thing in the morning and last thing at night.
I feel restless when I try to put my phone down.
I feel I don't have control over my own time.
I feel I'm behind on everything because of how I spend time.
